bio: Fancy a little pick me up? Tuck into Afternoon Tea treats and sip on freshly brewed coffee or tea at Mill Bar and Grill in Stowmarket, Suffolk.  Situated next to the river Gipping in Stowmarket, this lovely bar and grill is the perfect spot for an afternoon treat. Mill Bar and Grill pride themselves in using the finest ingredients from local suppliers, so you can expect fresh and delicious creations made by the talented chefs and bakers.  Expect house-made fruit scones with lashings of clotted cream and jam, freshly-made sandwiches on white and brown bread, as well as an assortment of freshly baked cakes and tray bakes. Enjoy a pot of tea or a freshy-brewed coffee.
